statements.text: Critical technologies such as artificial intelligence often have their own unique challenges when it comes to open-source software security. [...] If malicious actors manipulate or poison these datasets the models will be corrupted and could produce inaccurate or harmful outcomes.

statements.text: How did NIST work with industry in developing the AI Risk Management Framework? And how is having a tool like the framework going to strengthen consumer confidence when it comes to building trust in the AI systems?

statements.text: And, as academics, to me, the challenge is—I finished my dissertation on maternity healthcare in rural America. statements.text: Related to today's hearing, this initiative required the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to create a framework for managing risks associated with A.I. systems and best practices for sharing data to advance trustworthy A.I. systems.

statements.text: Additionally, it is important that trustworthy A.I. systems utilize robust data while also protecting the safety and security of user data. [...] So that must be our general goal: transparent and fair A.I. with accurate data and strong privacy protections.

statements.text: This bill provides for the establishment of a program to certify artificial intelligence software used in connection with producing agricultural products.
statements.context: Constitutional Authority and Single Subject Statement for H.R. 6806 filed in the House Congressional Record.

statements.text: From precision agriculture to veterinary software, the latest developments in agricultural technology – including artificial intelligence – have the power to lower input costs for farmers, protect the health of livestock and poultry, and make farming operations more efficient. However, we must be equally active in certifying that these new technologies, products, and processes work as they should and uphold the highest industry standards.
statements.venue: Press release on introducing the Farm Tech Act (via KWBG Radio)
